# Requirements

## REQ-001 Add task

functional, must

The system shall let the user add a task by entering a text description.

Acceptance criteria:

- Entering text and confirming adds a new task to the list
- The new task is shown as not done
- An empty task description is not added

## REQ-002 Mark task done

functional, must

The system shall let the user mark a task as done.

Acceptance criteria:

- Ticking a task changes it to the done state
- The done state is visibly distinguishable from the not-done state

## REQ-003 Persist tasks

functional, must

The system shall keep the user's tasks and their done state available when the user closes the app and returns later.

Acceptance criteria:

- After adding tasks and ticking some, closing and reopening the app shows the same tasks with the same done states

## REQ-004 Run in browser

non-functional, must

The system shall be usable in a web browser.

Acceptance criteria:

- All features are usable in a web browser without installing additional software

## Open questions

- Q-001: Where should tasks be stored? Browser-only storage (simple, but only that browser on that device) or on a server (available from other devices, needs a backend)? (REQ-003)
- Q-002: Should you be able to untick a task to mark it as not done again? (REQ-002)
- Q-003: Do you need to edit or delete tasks? (REQ-001)
- Q-004: Should done tasks stay in the list, move to a separate section, or be hideable? (REQ-002)
- Q-005: Is a task just a text description, or do you want extras such as due date, priority or categories? (REQ-001)
